summary:
MARS PATH – Explore Mars, Find Your Path

MARS PATH is an educational web platform designed to support the exploration and understanding of Mars. It provides an interactive map featuring important Martian exploration sites, a coordinate finder, and a distance calculator to help users explore the planet's surface.

The project uses topographic information derived from NASA's MOLA (Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter) data to help users understand Martian elevations and terrain. It also introduces a demonstration route-planning feature with illustrative hazard zones to explain how potential obstacles could affect a route.

MARS PATH aims to make Mars exploration data more accessible and understandable while demonstrating how planetary science data can be used in future exploration tools.

MARS PATH – Explore Mars, Find Your Path.
